note: Lean proves equality of histories and bare couplings at equal endpoints through uniqueness of the fixed point of the contraction (`solos`, `Cart.unique`), not through the one-line estimate D <= D/16.

lemma unique (he: V.veil T N X b z=z)(hh: z∈ Harbor N): V.picked h T N X hf (b:=b)=z:= by
   unfold picked; rw [dif_pos hv]; exact congr_arg Subtype.val ((harps h T N X V hf hv).fixedPoint_unique (x:=⟨z,hh⟩) (Subtype.ext he)).symm

proof_context.conclusion: A fixed point of `veil` in `Harbor N` equals `picked`, so the shooting solution at a given endpoint is unique.

lemma unions {g:∀ i,H.Home i} {w q:ℕ→ℝ}(hp:H.Shot g w q)(hy:w 0=A.B.a.clock.bar+b) (i)(hi:i≤N): f i=g i ∧ β i=w i ∧ s i=q i:= by
    have hh : port R N β=port R N w:= (H.solos u h V he hs hb hr hf).trans (H.solos u h V he hp hb hy hf).symm
    have he'(i)(hi:i≤N): f i=g i∧ β i=w i:=by
       refine ⟨(H.files hs i hi).symm.trans ((congr_arg (fun z=> H.file z i hi) hh).trans (H.files hp i hi)),?_⟩; exact (here (R:=R) (β:=β) i hi).symm.trans ((congr_arg (fun z=> lock R z i hi) hh).trans (here ..))
    induction hi using Nat.decreasingInduction with
    | self=> refine ⟨(he' N le_rfl).1,(he' N le_rfl).2,?_⟩; exact (show s N=0 from congr_arg RG.Rep.v hs.bare).trans (show q N=0 from congr_arg RG.Rep.v hp.bare).symm
    | of_succ i hi ih=> refine ⟨(he' i hi.le).1,(he' i hi.le).2,?_⟩; rw [(H.doors hs i hi).2.2,(H.doors hp i hi).2.2]; simp only [race,ih.1,ih.2.1,ih.2.2]

proof_context.conclusion: Two shot histories with the same endpoint `w 0 = bar + b` agree at every level (`f i = g i`, `β i = w i`, `s i = q i`).

lemma only (hB : Trial S N n b β): β=(S.realBeat b N n N).beta:= by
    obtain ⟨f,w,s,hV,hY,h⟩:=hB
    let hx := S.fits N n|>.acts (S.cart N n) (S.token N n) S.grove.coins hp'; rw [← hY]
    exact ((S.fits N n).unions S.grove.enabled S.grove.climbed (S.cart N n) (S.token N n) hV hp' h S.grove.coins hx.1 hx.2 N le_rfl).2.1

proof_context.conclusion: Any `Trial` with endpoint bar + b has bare coupling equal to `(realBeat b N n N).beta`.
